# Samz Fitness Hub

> A network of 4 neighbourhood gyms across Siliguri, West Bengal, India. Same brand, four locations: FIT-BEAT in Laketown, FITNESS HUB 2.0 in Arabinda Pally, FITNESS HUB 3.0 in central Siliguri, and FITNESS HUB 4.0 in Haiderpara. All branches offer transparent monthly and yearly memberships, personal training, and morning plus evening batches. The current offer waives the joining fee.

## Quick facts

- Brand: Samz Fitness Hub
- City: Siliguri, West Bengal, India
- Branches: 4

- Daily hours: 6:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 4:00 PM to 10:00 PM (Arabinda Pally morning slot ends 11:30 AM)

## Facilities (available at every branch)

- Clean equipment with a fixed maintenance routine
- Strength zone with power racks, benches, full dumbbell range
- Cardio floor with treadmills, cycles, dedicated warm-up space
- Stretch and mobility mat area
- Lockers and clean changing space
- Floor trainers for form guidance, optional personal training
